{{Quote|Well, that sure complicates things, Commander.''"<br />"''No worse than that time on Tibrin.''"<br />"''We had Jedi with us on Tibrin. They ''helped''.|Captain Rex and Commander Cody|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
The '''Battle of Tibrin''' of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] was a failed [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attempt to oust the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] presence from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The native [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] populace had previously welcomed the arrival of Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and his cadre of [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]], who [[Death/Legends|executed]] [[Suribran Tu]]&mdash;the planet's unpopular, pro-Republic [[Premier (Tibrin)|premier]]&mdash;and [[Tibrin revolution|overthrew]] his totalitarian [[Suribran Tu's regime|regime]]. Consequently, the Ishi Tib aided the Confederacy when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] came to retake Tibrin. The result was a catastrophic Republic defeat, with Tibrin retaining its Separatist ties. Many of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who survived the battle, including [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] of the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]], adopted a [[Hair/Legends|hairstyle]] called the [[double stripe]] to honor their fallen comrades.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Sora Bulq. Take charge of the local government until a new one is in place. Kill ''everyone'' in Tu's inner circle&mdash;generals, politicians, family. Kadrian Sey. You and Tol Skorr clear away the body. Let the populace see that he's dead. Mount his head somewhere ''highly'' visible.|Dooku issues orders to his Dark Acolytes following his murder of Suribran Tu|<ref name="Jedi: Count Dooku" />}}
[[File:Tibrin_Seps.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Ishi Tib laud Dooku's execution of Suribran Tu.]]
Since the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the native [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] inhabitants of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]] clamored to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CSWE: Tu">{{CSWECite|III|267|Tu, Suribran}}</ref> Yet the planet's dictatorial [[Premier (Tibrin)|premier]],<ref name="FF 134">{{FactFile|134|TYR 1-2|Rise of a Tyrant}}</ref> [[Suribran Tu]], retained the support of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], even though his [[Suribran Tu's regime|administration]] oppressed the will of the people and was marred by corrupt practices, such as strong-arm tactics and [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassinations]].<ref name="CSWE: Tu" />

When Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] came to negotiate for the rights to use Tibrin as a base,<ref name="CSWE: Tu" /> he was unimpressed with Tu's willingness to become a Separatist-loyal planetary ruler simply as a means of preserving his own position and power. Seeing no benefit to further deliberations, Dooku [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] Tu with his [[Dooku's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and had the ex-dictator's head publicly displayed for the citizenry to see. Dooku also installed one of his [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]], [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]],<ref name="Jedi: Count Dooku">''[[Jedi: Count Dooku]]''</ref> as Tibrin's provisional [[Governor/Legends|governor]],<ref name="CSWE: Tu" /> with orders to [[Death/Legends|purge]] Tu's inner circle&mdash;everyone from military and political [[Officer/Legends|officers]] to his family. The Ishi Tib population, grateful to be free of Tu and the Republic, extolled Dooku as a liberator and eagerly joined the Confederacy, inciting a [[Tibrin revolution|revolution]] on their world.<ref name="Jedi: Count Dooku" />

==The battle==
Unwilling to let the Confederacy's influence on Tibrin go unchallenged, the Republic sent [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]<ref name="FF-2014 32: Gree" /> and [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|clone subtrooper]]<ref name="TCWCG" /> forces from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="FF-2014 32: Gree" /> The forces operated under the command of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] officers<ref name="Rookies" />&mdash;including [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]<ref name="TCWCG" />&mdash;to uproot Dooku's [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] presence on Tibrin. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] of the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]],<ref name="FF-2014 32: Gree" /> [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] of the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] were among the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] [[Troop/Legends|troop]] leadership.<ref name="Rookies" /> However, the Ishi Tib resisted the Republic's attempts to meddle in their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] affairs. The campaign ended in a crushing defeat for the Republic forces, with many [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] perishing in the battle.<ref name="FF-2014 32: Gree" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Gree_CoD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Commander Gree was one of many Tibrin survivors to wear the double stripe.]]
The Battle of Tibrin, as the grisly campaign came to be known, resulted in the Ishi Tib preserving their loyalty to the Confederacy.<ref name="FF-2014 32: Gree" /> Though they continued to send a [[Senator/Legends|representative]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]]<ref name="Starships Collection 25">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|25|Star Wars A&ndash;Z}}</ref> in the form of Senator [[Gume Saam/Legends|Gume Saam]], he held clandestine connections to the Separatists and the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], becoming involved in a war-profiteering plot to thwart a [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace initiative]] between the Republic and the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>

During Rex and Cody's [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|mission]] to the [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]], during which they were forced to escape from skilled [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], Cody recalled the Battle of Tibrin as a similar situation, although Rex was quick to point out they had enjoyed Jedi support on Tibrin.<ref name="Rookies" /> To honor the comrades they lost at Tibrin, Gree and many other clone survivors of the battle adopted a [[Color/Legends|red]]-colored [[Hair/Legends|buzz cut]] that became known as the [[double stripe]].<ref name="Cloak of Darkness Decoded" /> Commander Cody, meanwhile, would adopt a stripe upon his upper right arm<ref name="LOE" /> on his [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]]<ref name="Revenge">{{Film|III}}</ref> to signify his service at Tibrin, which joined numerous other stripes that signified various other campaigns in which he had served.<ref name="LOE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Tibrin was first mentioned, albeit unidentified, in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="LOE" /> The event was later identified in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 32|thirty-second issue]] of the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2013)|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'']] series,<ref name="FF-2014 32: Gree" /> which was published on [[August 13]], [[2014]]<ref name="Date">{{FactFile2014Dates|32}}</ref> and written by [[Iain Lowson]].<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref>
